controls.title: Secure Development Environments
controls.description: The software is developed and built in secure environments. Those environments are secured by the following actions at a minimum:

controls.title: Environment Separation and Protection
controls.description: Separating and protecting each environment involved in developing and building software;

controls.title: Trust Relationship Monitoring
controls.description: Regularly logging, monitoring, and auditing trust relationships used for authorization and access:

controls.title: Development Environment Access Logging
controls.description: to any software development and build environments; and

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
controls.description: Enforcing multi-factor authentication and conditional access across the environments relevant to developing and building software in a manner that minimizes security risk;

controls.title: Risky Software Minimization
controls.description: Taking consistent and reasonable steps to document as well as minimize use or inclusion of software products that create undue risk within the environments used to develop and build software;

controls.title: Sensitive Data Encryption
controls.description: Encrypting sensitive data such as credentials to the extent practicable and based on risk;

controls.title: Defensive Cybersecurity Practices
controls.description: Implementing defensive cybersecurity practices including continuous monitoring of operations and alerts and as necessary responding to suspected and confirmed cyber incidents;

controls.title: Source Code Supply Chain Security
controls.description: The software producer makes a good-faith effort to maintain trusted source code supply chains by employing automated tools or comparable processes to address the security of internal code and third-party components and manage related vulnerabilities;

controls.title: Software Provenance
controls.description: The software producer maintains provenance for internal code and third-party components incorporated into the software to the greatest extent feasible;

controls.title: Automated Vulnerability Checks
controls.description: The software producer employed automated tools or comparable processes that check for security vulnerabilities. In addition:

controls.title: Ongoing Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: The software producer operates these processes on an ongoing basis and prior to product version or update releases;

controls.title: Pre-Release Vulnerability Remediation
controls.description: The software producer has a policy or process to address discovered security vulnerabilities prior to product release; and

controls.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
controls.description: The software producer operates a vulnerability disclosure program and accepts reviews and addresses disclosed software vulnerabilities in a timely fashion and according to any timelines specified in the vulnerability disclosure program or applicable policies.
